areas.name: Thinking (18 planning docs)
areas.note: Vision, roles, permissions, data model, stock, customers, auth, platform, design, languages, reports, stack, api, edge cases, ideas, roadmap, open questions.

areas.name: Clickable demo (GitHub Pages)
areas.note: Live with every planned flow in English, Greek and Russian, on phones and desktop. Passed an independent Apple design review: 45 fixes applied (contrast, tab labels, accent discipline, sticky receive, modal composer, edge swipe back, reduced transparency, self hosted font).

areas.name: Monorepo and tooling
areas.note: pnpm workspace, TypeScript, local check script. No CI/CD.

areas.name: Shared packages (contract, tokens, translations)
areas.note: API contract and client interface, design tokens, en/el/ru common translations with tested plurals.

areas.name: Backend (permissions engine, database, API)
areas.note: 380 api tests and 100 core tests. One sign in per browser with a device list, spent sign ins, codes and finished jobs cleared on their own so the database stays small, the daily stock check against the ledger.

areas.name: Web app for phone and desktop
areas.note: The phone app and the admin in one. The camera reads one item at a time inside the frame, a shelf label held still counts once, with a beep. Pages show what is true now when you come back to them. Shops are added from Settings.

areas.name: Production server
areas.note: Live on its own subdomain with real email, web push and photos in a bucket. Tested end to end with real email, push on an iPhone and the camera, then wiped: only the super admin is left, every option back to its default.

areas.name: Super admin and settings
areas.note: Every business in one place, feature switches, pausing, emergency switches, the free storage meter, errors, server info, every limit from the platform down to one person, and each signed in device with its own sign out.

areas.name: Testing
areas.note: A full live test on production: owner, staff, customer, approvals, transfers, counts, offers, back in stock by email and push, and the camera. 15 issues it found are fixed, each with a test. End to end tests run with a stand-in camera too.

log.text: Repo created, thinking started.
All 18 thinking docs written. Repo public, GitHub Pages on.
Monorepo set up: Next.js 16, Hono, SQLite. Shared contract, tokens and translations in place.
Backend, web and phone app being built in parallel.
Demo stage 1 is live on GitHub Pages. Stage 2 started.
Demo stage 2 live: team and roles, reports, counts, transfers, lock screen, customer join flow and profile.
Backend stage 1 done: core rules, database with seed data, read API, 103 tests passing.
Web app first version done and wired to the real API. Apple design review of the demo done, 45 fixes being applied.
Backend write side done: ledger, counts, transfers, posts sending, invites, audit log. 142 tests passing. Security review started.
Phone app first version done: work side with scanning and customer side, wired to the real API.
Demo design review fixes live. Screens from the real web and phone apps added here.
Security review of the backend done: 31 findings, all being fixed with regression tests.
All 31 security findings fixed, 186 backend tests passing. Deploy setup and performance work started.
Web app second round done: counts, transfers, product form, audit log, dev outbox, every action on the real API, end to end flow passing.
Backend ready for a server: external login adapter, live transports kept off, fast search, OpenAPI, deploy files and backups. Web design review fixes in progress.
Web design review applied: tables on wide screens, staff today screen, audit in plain sentences, photo upload. Screenshots refreshed.
Decision: the website is the phone app, added to the home screen.
First production deploy: one container, real email and push, photos in a bucket, every email in the app look.
Building super admin, feature switches, error tracking, forgot password and profile photos. Fixes from the first live check.
Super admin above every business, feature switches, error log, API docs and server info.
Live test in the browser: owner invite, push to a device, logo and product photos in the bucket, selling and receiving by barcode and shelf QR.
Every limit and option configurable by the level above, own date picker, shelf labels, security review and fixes, moving to its own subdomain.
Moved to its own subdomain. Security review fixed: uploads, email change, join limits, headers, lockouts.
iPhone fixes from real device tests: sheets and the keyboard, landscape, focus rings. Navigation with the business in the address. Production cleaned for testers.
First bug hunt: 37 bugs fixed across stock, customers, super admin, languages and accessibility, security and speed. 195 end to end tests green.
Second bug hunt: edge cases, real life timing (two people, two devices, offline, expiry, deploys, clock changes) and a big busy business. Pages about 40 percent lighter. 210 end to end tests green.

Live test on production with real email, push on an iPhone and the camera. Fixed: the camera counting one label many times, a lost scan behind a slow one, push consent from the app switch, back in stock and post push texts, lost in transit in shrinkage, forgot password for customers, sign ins piling up, a job queued every 5 seconds. Test data wiped. 100%.
